codex.root_final_source: From output.app_server_events select entries whose runtime_generation equals output.runtime_generation, message.method is rawResponseItem/completed, message.params.threadId equals output.thread_id, message.params.turnId equals output.turn_id, item.type is message, item.role is assistant, and item.phase is final_answer. Require exactly one such item; join its content parts of type output_text in order. The selected current-root final_answer also carries one direct result object matching the stage5-rebuild-overview call aggregatedOutput, separately from every unchanged per-professor result; grouping property names are not contractual and nested diagnostics or history are excluded.
root_final_exclusions: different turnId including earlier root turns
owner_business_input_exclusions: child task input delivered as item.type agent_message with an input_text NEW_TASK shell plus encrypted_content, which carries no plaintext business object
items of other threads or other runtime generations
business objects in command texts that do not invoke a supported stage5 CLI; echo/log and diagnostic examples are not consumption evidence
codex.owner_input_isolation: 待第二关口审核：每个教授调用只能使用该教授自己的数据；不得含有兄弟教授数据或 choices_scope。依据同次调用观察到的解析对象和结构化计划输出判定。
codex.canonical_preservation: 待第二关口审核：实际解析对象中的 choices、professor_dir、email_pack 和 email_id 必须保持原值。事后文件读取、命令文字、无关输出和教授自述不构成输入证据。
codex.partition_evidence: The root must execute the supported stage5-partition-choices entry exactly once successfully on the root thread, with per-owner bundles matching the manifest partition record; a partition executed by a child, more than one successful root partition, or no successful root partition is a product failure. The successful root partition must also complete before any owner business call starts: an owner business command on a child thread that starts before the partition completed is a product failure (owner_business_precedes_partition). Discovery must not carry --emit-choices-scope and a plan must not carry --choices-scope.
codex.orchestration_surface: Root orchestration (discovery, partition, rebuild) is recognized on two surfaces: a call whose command parses strictly under the frozen flag grammar keeps every flag fact, and a compound preparation command (python3 -c / wrapper expression whose action words are quoted string fragments) is attributed by the loose business-surface text shape plus its single stage5 action word. Output facts always come from the commandExecution aggregatedOutput on both surfaces. Compound commands provide no flags, so the --emit-choices-scope, --choices-scope and --program-root checks only cover strictly parsed calls. A compound text carrying two or more action words cannot be attributed to one orchestration step and is BLOCKED_OBSERVABILITY/root_orchestration_ambiguous; on a child thread only a strictly parsed partition, or a compound text whose single action word is stage5-partition-choices, proves partition_executed_by_owner. Require exactly one root stage5-rebuild-overview call after every formal owner result has a current-turn root consumption receipt; its start must be later than every receipt consumption point. Read its result only from that call commandExecution aggregatedOutput. Successful output has status=ok and overview_md, professors and emails, with no reason_code. soft_exit/fail returns status and reason_code plus its result-specific fields, and may have nonzero exit status. The selected root final answer must separately report the exact aggregate result object with all unchanged per-professor result objects; a faithfully reported needs_decision or error aggregate is valid and does not alter professor outcomes. Grouping property names are not frozen and examples such as results or overview are illustrative. Associate direct result objects by their product fields; never search nested diagnostics, prior turns, logs or history for substitute results.
codex.wait_consume_evidence: The formal child set stays the shared adapter's spawnAgent relation: dispatch.thread_relations edges whose tool is spawnAgent and whose sender_thread_id equals the root thread id name the formal children, and identity diagnostics never create, rewrite, upgrade or downgrade ownership. The child_thread_id to child_agent_path binding comes only from the same run's subAgentActivity items (message.params.item.type is subAgentActivity and item.agentThreadId equals the child thread id): the item's agentPath is the association key only and never formal ownership. The root's only legal consumption receipt for one formal child is a root-thread rawResponseItem/completed agent_message item of the same runtime_generation and the current turn (message.params.turnId equals output.turn_id) whose item.recipient is /root and whose item.author equals that child's agent path; its input_text body must be exactly the Codex child completion shape — the header lines 'Message Type: FINAL_ANSWER', 'Task name: /root' and 'Sender: <child_agent_path>' (the Sender line must equal the child's agent path), then the 'Payload:' marker followed by exactly one JSON object carrying professor_dir, status and reason_code. The receipt's runtime_seq is the root's consumption point for that child's result and the stage5-rebuild-overview aggregate must not start before every owner's receipt consumption point (aggregate_precedes_result_consumption); a legal receipt whose payload outcome differs from the outcome the child itself returned on its own thread is FAIL_PRODUCT/root_receipt_payload_changed. collabAgentToolCall receiverThreadIds/agentsStates, the 'Wait completed.' wait message, subAgentActivity completed reports, child turn/completed events, requested_role and loaded_identity are diagnostics only and never consumption evidence. A child without an agentPath mapping or without a legal receipt stays BLOCKED_OBSERVABILITY with reason code root_result_consumption_unobservable and is never passed on the strength of the diagnostic surfaces; legal receipts carrying more than one distinct outcome triple stay INVALID_EVIDENCE/root_result_receipt_ambiguous; when no uniquely attributable receipt exists the verifier never guesses a PASS. The receipt's Payload JSON is read at its top level only and never recursively through nested objects: the object must carry professor_dir as a top-level field and the outcome triple comes from the top-level fields alone, so a receipt whose top level carries only a nested object (a diagnostic wrapper, for example) is never a consumption receipt. The child to agentPath mapping must be unique per formal child: a child with no agentPath mapping stays BLOCKED_OBSERVABILITY/root_result_consumption_unobservable (missing_agent_path_mapping), a child observed under more than one distinct agentPath is INVALID_EVIDENCE/child_agent_path_mapping_ambiguous regardless of how correct the surviving path's own receipt looks, and only a unique mapping binds receipts to that one agent path author.
codex.terminal_precedence: A proven FAIL_PRODUCT is never downgraded to a blocked or invalid terminal by another formal child's missing or ambiguous evidence.
codex.formal_ownership: Use the shared adapter @16 formal topology only. Identity diagnostics cannot create, rewrite, upgrade or downgrade ownership.
